November 2026 is an odd month for Spotlight Hours in Pokemon GO , with only two confirmed events (via Leekduck) instead of the usual four (one each week).
Why Are There Only Two Pokemon GO Spotlight Hours in November 2026?
For the autumnal month, the two Spotlight events we know of so far take place on November 5 and November 26, featuring Teddiursa in a witch hat and Noibat , respectively. We don't know why there are only two Spotlight Hours in November, but it could be because of other events, such as GO Wild Area 2026 and the Minior Showers: Leonids 2026, the latter of which runs concurrently with the Spotlight Hour timing. Scopely/Niantic hasn't confirmed the reasoning, but we'll update this post if we hear more.
Pokemon GO November 2026 Spotlight Hour Schedule
As we mentioned, there are only two confirmed Spotlight Hour events for November in Pokemon GO . The Witch Hat Teddiursa event , like other Spotlight Hours, starts at 6 PM local time and runs for an hour. The bonus for this one is double evolution XP.
For the Noibat event on the 26th, the bonus is double Candy for catching Pokemon.
To evolve Noibat into Noivern in Pokemon GO , you need 400 Noibat Candy . To evolve Teddiursa into Ursaring, you'll need 50 Teddiursa Candy. You can also evolve Ursaring into Ursaluna, but you'll need 100 Candy and have to wait until a Full Moon .
How to Take Advantage of the Spotlight Hour Bonuses
For the double evolution XP bonus, keep plenty of Pokemon ready to evolve that don't require much Candy , such as Pidgey, Weedle, Caterpie, and Wurmple. You can also use Lucky Eggs to earn even more XP during the hour.
For extra Catch Candy, prep to catch a lot of Pokemon , and make sure you have space in your storage. Be sure to use Pinap Berries during encounters , along with Lures and Incenses.
Are Pokemon GO Spotlight Hours Still Happening Every Thursday?
Since June 2026, Pokemon GO Spotlight Hours have shifted from Tuesday to Thursday. We don't know how long this will last, but it seems like it'll stick for now.
